labelProvenance: Astra/high supervisor reviewed all 60 public PR title/body cases and all 511 original source labels on 2026-09-14 before this comparison's B/C responses were generated. Original UTF-16 source spans, texts, order and boundaries are unchanged; nine classifications corrected with explicit reasons. Machine-reviewed evaluation annotations, NOT human-verified gold. Concrete PR-title objectives are requirements regardless of tense or slang when context resolves intent. Retrospective implementation accounts with unclear normative intent remain ambiguous; historical context, examples, upstream quotations, process/templates and result claims are non-requirements. Coarse paragraph/list/table units remain a measurement limitation.
